counterexamples.title: Duplicate positive replacement rows silently collapse
counterexamples.observed_by_source: pairs[old.key] = (old,new) overwrites prior pair and no duplicate-pair length check exists
counterexamples.required_behavior: Reject duplicate affected outcomes before canonicalization

counterexamples.title: Forbidden noncurrent replacement_ref and receipt schema are ignored on deserialize
constructions: Serialize a valid NoncurrentDependentOutcome, replace replacement_ref:null with an arbitrary exact ref, retain canonical record_ref; from_dict discards forged value and reconstructs null.
Delete replacement_ref entirely; from_dict synthesizes null.
For a negative AuthorityInvalidationReceipt, delete or forge receipt_schema; from_dict never inspects it.
counterexamples.why_record_ref_check_does_not_save_it: The ignored fields are discarded before deterministic ref reconstruction, so the reconstructed canonical ref can still equal the supplied record_ref.
counterexamples.required_behavior: Require explicit null replacement_ref and exact negative schema; reject malformed legacy/new-schema mixing.

counterexamples.title: Owner-unknown dependent ref is reported CURRENT
counterexamples.construction: Call dependent_lifecycle_status() or resolve_current_analytical_product() with an exact ref absent from determinant_graph.known_dependent_refs.
counterexamples.observed_by_source: If no release touches the ref, the method unconditionally returns lifecycle_state=CURRENT without a known-dependent membership check.
counterexamples.required_behavior: Return/refuse a typed owner-unknown state; never grant CURRENT to an unregistered dependent.

counterexamples.title: Restore path re-proves A but trusts serialized U
counterexamples.construction: Provide a self-consistently rehashed checkpoint whose invalidation affected set matches graph.affected(changed) but whose unaffected set omits a graph-known sibling; update dependent receipt/release/event identities consistently.
counterexamples.observed_by_source: Replay compares expected_affected only. No graph.unaffected(expected_affected) equality check exists.
counterexamples.required_behavior: Recompute and require exact unaffected set equality so A and U are disjoint and cover K during restore.
